review_kind: AI technical review (Codex), no native-speaker signoff
note: Direct AI translation and technical review against current English source and code context. German, French and Icelandic, plus the 35 historical Hindi captions, also received a second independent Codex AI technical review. No native-speaker signoff. Hindi historical IDs 821–855 were directly translated after content review; no external translation filter was invoked. Prior fallback history remains in earlier evidence. 2026-10-06: the revised Cell-DINO caption received direct Codex AI technical review only; earlier independent-review statements apply to its previous wording. All other records retain their existing review history.

records.key: A model trained on microscopy rather than photographs. OpenPhenom and ChAda-ViT take any number of stains; SubCell takes two, DNA then the stain of interest, in the order the channels are encoded. Weights download once. Cell-DINO needs an official checkpoint and is not yet supported by this version. Default None (use the backbone).
records.source: A model trained on microscopy rather than photographs. OpenPhenom and ChAda-ViT take any number of stains; SubCell takes two, DNA then the stain of interest, in the order the channels are encoded. Weights download once. Cell-DINO needs an official checkpoint and is not yet supported by this version. Default None (use the backbone).
records.translation: Líkan þjálfað á smásjármyndum fremur en ljósmyndum. OpenPhenom og ChAda-ViT taka við hvaða fjölda litana sem er; SubCell tekur tvær, DNA fyrst og síðan litunina sem á að skoða, í þeirri röð sem rásirnar eru kóðaðar. Vægi eru sótt einu sinni. Cell-DINO þarf opinbera vistun af líkaninu og er ekki enn stutt í þessari útgáfu. Sjálfgefið: None (nota grunnnetið).

records.source: A pandas query on microscope_event_table choosing which objects are events, for example pathogen_area > 200 or cell_channel_1_mean_intensity > 900. Blank makes every object an event, up to microscope_max_events per field. Default blank.
records.translation: pandas-fyrirspurn á microscope_event_table sem velur hvaða hlutir teljast atburðir, til dæmis pathogen_area > 200 eða cell_channel_1_mean_intensity > 900. Tómt gildi gerir hvern hlut að atburði, að hámarki microscope_max_events í hverjum myndreit. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.key: A spaCR label mask (.npy or image) of this object type, made from the image above. Default empty.
records.source: A spaCR label mask (.npy or image) of this object type, made from the image above. Default empty.
records.translation: spaCR-merkigríma (.npy eða mynd) fyrir þessa hlutategund, gerð úr myndinni að ofan. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.source: A table (.csv, .xlsx or .parquet) of the stage position each field was acquired at, with the columns field (the field name the watch prints, such as plate1_A01_0001_001), x and y in micrometres at the image centre, and optionally z. Events in a field missing from it are recorded but not imaged. Default blank.
records.translation: Tafla (.csv, .xlsx eða .parquet) yfir stöðu smásjárborðs við töku hvers myndreits, með dálkunum field (nafn myndreitsins sem vöktunin birtir, svo sem plate1_A01_0001_001), x og y í míkrómetrum við miðju myndar og valfrjálsum z. Atburðir í myndreit sem vantar í töfluna eru skráðir en ekki myndaðir. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.source: A trained event model (event_model.pt from an earlier run) to apply when timelapse_events_annotations is blank. It is read as tensors only. Default None.
records.translation: Þjálfað atburðalíkan (event_model.pt úr fyrri keyrslu) sem er notað þegar timelapse_events_annotations er tómt. Það er aðeins lesið sem tensorar. Sjálfgefið: None.

records.source: After the masks are made, re-segment a few sampled fields with the diameter, the flow and cell-probability thresholds and contrast enhancement each moved a little, and report how much the object count, median area, mean object intensity and the objects themselves change. Settings whose results move more than robustness_tolerance are flagged fragile. Writes qc/segmentation_robustness_<object>.csv and a heatmap. Two-dimensional Cellpose-SAM runs only. Default False.
records.translation: Eftir að grímurnar eru gerðar eru nokkrir úrtaksmyndreitir hlutagreindir aftur með smávægilegum breytingum, hverri fyrir sig, á þvermáli, flæðis- og frumulíkindaþröskuldum og birtuskilabætingu. Skýrslan sýnir hve mikið hlutafjöldi, miðgildi flatarmáls, meðalstyrkur hluta og hlutirnir sjálfir breytast. Stillingar sem breyta niðurstöðum meira en robustness_tolerance eru merktar viðkvæmar. Skrifar qc/segmentation_robustness_<object>.csv og hitakort. Aðeins fyrir tvívíðar Cellpose-SAM-keyrslur. Sjálfgefið: False.

records.source: After the run, detect events on every tracked object with a small neural network that reads short windows of each track (shape, intensity, movement, tracks starting or ending nearby, and image crops): mitosis, egress, invasion, host death or whatever classes timelapse_events_annotations names. Writes time-stamped events, lineage trees re-linked from detected mitoses and Kaplan-Meier time to each event per condition to tracks/events. Runs on the CPU. Default False.
records.translation: Eftir keyrslu eru atburðir greindir á hverjum hlut sem fylgt hefur verið eftir, með litlu tauganeti sem les stutta glugga úr hverri ferilslóð (lögun, styrk, hreyfingu, slóðir sem hefjast eða enda nálægt og myndútskurði): mítósu, útgöngu, innrás, dauða hýsilfrumu eða þá flokka sem timelapse_events_annotations nefnir. Skrifar tímastimplaða atburði, ættartré með tengingum endurgerðum út frá greindum mítósum og Kaplan-Meier-tíma að hverjum atburði fyrir hvert skilyrði í tracks/events. Keyrir á CPU. Sjálfgefið: False.

records.source: Also re-segment each sampled field after contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalisation (CLAHE), to see whether contrast enhancement changes what the model finds. Default True.
records.translation: Hlutagreina einnig hvern úrtaksmyndreit aftur eftir aðlagaða jöfnun tíðnirits með takmörkuðum birtuskilum (CLAHE), til að sjá hvort bætt birtuskil breyti því sem líkanið finnur. Sjálfgefið: True.

records.key: An access token, for a server or topic that needs one. Kept like a password. Leave empty to keep the saved one. Default empty.
records.source: An access token, for a server or topic that needs one. Kept like a password. Leave empty to keep the saved one. Default empty.
records.translation: Aðgangstákn fyrir þjón eða efnisrás sem þarfnast slíks. Varðveitt eins og lykilorð. Hafðu tómt til að halda því vistaða. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.source: Assign and write
records.translation: Úthluta og skrifa

records.key: Call hits above the negative control, below it, or both.
records.source: Call hits above the negative control, below it, or both.
records.translation: Greinir jákvæðar niðurstöður ofan neikvæða viðmiðsins, neðan þess eða í báðar áttir.

records.source: Cell-probability thresholds the robustness report tries in place of the run's own, one at a time. Lower grows objects and finds faint ones; higher shrinks or drops them. Default [-2.0, 2.0].
records.translation: Frumulíkindaþröskuldar sem þolskýrslan prófar í stað þess sem keyrslan notar, einn í einu. Lægra gildi stækkar hluti og finnur daufa hluti; hærra minnkar þá eða fellir þá út. Sjálfgefið: [-2.0, 2.0].

records.key: Choose a per-cell table with a 'well' column, a 'well_label' column (1 for treated or knockout wells, 0 for controls) and embedding or numeric feature columns. An attention model learns from the well labels alone which cells carry the phenotype. Two tables are written beside the input: each cell's attention and each well's probability. Runs on the CPU. Default 4-fold cross-validation over wells.
records.source: Choose a per-cell table with a 'well' column, a 'well_label' column (1 for treated or knockout wells, 0 for controls) and embedding or numeric feature columns. An attention model learns from the well labels alone which cells carry the phenotype. Two tables are written beside the input: each cell's attention and each well's probability. Runs on the CPU. Default 4-fold cross-validation over wells.
records.translation: Veldu töflu með einni færslu fyrir hverja frumu, dálkinum 'well', dálkinum 'well_label' (1 fyrir meðhöndlaða brunna eða brunna með genaslátt, 0 fyrir viðmið) og dálkum með ívörpunum eða tölulegum eiginleikum. Athyglislíkan lærir af brunnmerkingunum einum hvaða frumur bera svipgerðina. Tvær töflur eru skrifaðar við hlið inntaksins: athyglisvægi hverrar frumu og líkur hvers brunns. Keyrir á CPU. Sjálfgefið: 4-föld krossprófun yfir brunna.

records.key: Choose a per-cell table with well labels
records.source: Choose a per-cell table with well labels
records.translation: Veldu frumutöflu með brunnmerkingum

records.key: Choose the platform output folder first.
records.source: Choose the platform output folder first.
records.translation: Veldu fyrst úttaksmöppu kerfisins.

records.source: Conditions compared in the event timing, as name=wells entries in the plate-map notation, such as ['mock=c1,c2', 'drug=c3,c4']; fields in wells no entry names are left out. Blank compares wells. Default None.
records.translation: Skilyrði sem eru borin saman í tímasetningu atburða, sem name=wells-færslur með táknmáli plötukorts, svo sem ['mock=c1,c2', 'drug=c3,c4']; myndreitum í brunnum sem engin færsla nefnir er sleppt. Tómt gildi ber saman brunna. Sjálfgefið: None.

records.source: Could not assign: {error}
records.translation: Gat ekki úthlutað: {error}

records.source: Could not load: {error}
records.translation: Gat ekki hlaðið inn: {error}

records.key: Download about {size} MB of SYNTHETIC test data: two-colour images drawn by spaCR, segmented by Mask with Cellpose-SAM, then measured by Measure. No real cells were imaged. A staining-control column and two conditions have a known share of invaded parasites; ground truth records the drawn objects, not the segmented masks. Settings are filled in, so Run is the next step. Cached after the first download.
records.source: Download about {size} MB of SYNTHETIC test data: two-colour images drawn by spaCR, segmented by Mask with Cellpose-SAM, then measured by Measure. No real cells were imaged. A staining-control column and two conditions have a known share of invaded parasites; ground truth records the drawn objects, not the segmented masks. Settings are filled in, so Run is the next step. Cached after the first download.
records.translation: Sækir um {size} MB af TILBÚNUM prófunargögnum: tvílita myndir teiknaðar af spaCR, hlutagreindar af Mask með Cellpose-SAM og síðan mældar með Measure. Engar raunverulegar frumur voru myndaðar. Dálkur með litunarviðmiði og tvö skilyrði hafa þekkt hlutfall sníkjudýra sem hafa ráðist inn; sannleiksgögnin lýsa teiknuðu hlutunum, ekki hlutagreindu grímunum. Stillingarnar eru fylltar út svo næsta skref er Keyra. Gögnin eru skyndivistuð eftir fyrsta niðurhal.

records.source: Flow thresholds the robustness report tries in place of the run's own, one at a time. Higher keeps objects whose flows are less consistent. Default [0.2, 0.6].
records.translation: Flæðisþröskuldar sem þolskýrslan prófar í stað þess sem keyrslan notar, einn í einu. Hærra gildi heldur hlutum með ósamræmdara flæði. Sjálfgefið: [0.2, 0.6].

records.source: Foundation model:
records.translation: Grunnlíkan:

records.source: Four numbers [a, b, c, d] turning a pixel offset from the image centre (dx columns, dy rows) into a stage move of (a*dx + b*dy, c*dx + d*dy) micrometres. For a pixel size p with camera and stage axes aligned use [p, 0, 0, p]; negate a term for a flipped axis and swap them for a camera turned 90 degrees. Default [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0].
records.translation: Fjórar tölur [a, b, c, d] sem umbreyta hliðrun í mynddílum frá miðju myndar (dx dálkum, dy röðum) í færslu smásjárborðs um (a*dx + b*dy, c*dx + d*dy) míkrómetra. Fyrir mynddílastærð p með ása myndavélar og borðs samstillta er notað [p, 0, 0, p]; breyttu formerki liðar fyrir viðsnúinn ás og víxlaðu liðunum ef myndavélinni er snúið um 90 gráður. Sjálfgefið: [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0].

records.source: Frames the detector sees around each frame of a track, centred on it; an even number is raised by one. Longer windows see slower changes but blur events close together. Only read when training. Default 9.
records.translation: Fjöldi ramma sem greinirinn sér í kringum hvern ramma ferilslóðar, með þann ramma í miðju; slétt tala er hækkuð um einn. Lengri gluggar sjá hægari breytingar en þoka út atburðum sem eru nærri hver öðrum. Aðeins lesið við þjálfun. Sjálfgefið: 9.

records.key: Give at least one mask and the measurement database.
records.source: Give at least one mask and the measurement database.
records.translation: Tilgreindu að minnsta kosti eina grímu og mæligagnagrunninn.

records.key: How SSMD is estimated from the negative control: method of moments, the unbiased estimate, or the median and MAD.
records.source: How SSMD is estimated from the negative control: method of moments, the unbiased estimate, or the median and MAD.
records.translation: Hvernig SSMD er metið út frá neikvæða viðmiðinu: vægjaaðferð, óbjagað mat eða miðgildi og MAD.

records.source: How many fields the robustness report samples at random (seeded by random_seed) and re-segments at every grid point. More fields give a steadier verdict; each field costs one segmentation per grid point. Default 4.
records.translation: Hve marga myndreiti þolskýrslan velur af handahófi (með random_seed sem sáðgildi) og hlutagreinir aftur við hvern punkt í grindinni. Fleiri myndreitir gefa stöðugra mat; hver myndreitur kostar eina hlutagreiningu fyrir hvern grindarpunkt. Sjálfgefið: 4.

records.source: How many images the microscope takes at each event: 1 is a single snapshot, more makes a timelapse spaced microscope_interval_seconds apart. The microscope keeps its current channel, objective and exposure. Default 1.
records.translation: Hve margar myndir smásjáin tekur við hvern atburð: 1 er ein kyrrmynd, fleiri gefa tímaraðir með microscope_interval_seconds milli mynda. Smásjáin heldur núverandi rás, hlutlinsu og lýsingartíma. Sjálfgefið: 1.

records.source: Image level
records.translation: Myndstig

records.source: Landmarks
records.translation: Kennileiti

records.source: Largest median relative change in object count, median area or mean intensity, or share of the run's objects not found again, that still counts as stable. A grid point beyond it is flagged fragile. Default 0.2.
records.translation: Mesta miðgildi hlutfallslegrar breytingar á hlutafjölda, miðgildi flatarmáls eða meðalstyrk, eða hlutfall hluta keyrslunnar sem finnast ekki aftur, sem telst enn stöðugt. Grindarpunktur yfir því marki er merktur viðkvæmur. Sjálfgefið: 0.2.

records.translation: Læra af brunnmerkingum…

records.translation: Læri af brunnmerkingum…

records.key: Mitosis, egress, invasion and host death detected on tracks by a small network trained on annotated events, with held-out precision and recall, division links re-made from mitoses and time to each event per condition.
records.source: Mitosis, egress, invasion and host death detected on tracks by a small network trained on annotated events, with held-out precision and recall, division links re-made from mitoses and time to each event per condition.
records.translation: Mítósa, útganga, innrás og dauði hýsilfrumu greind á ferilslóðum með litlu neti þjálfuðu á merktum atburðum, með hittni og heimt á fráteknum gögnum, skiptingartengingum endurgerðum út frá mítósum og tíma að hverjum atburði fyrir hvert skilyrði.

records.source: Multiples of the object diameter the robustness report tries, one at a time; a blank diameter counts as Cellpose's nominal 30 pixels. Default [0.75, 1.25].
records.translation: Margfeldi þvermáls hluta sem þolskýrslan prófar, eitt í einu; tómt þvermál telst nafngildi Cellpose, 30 mynddílar. Sjálfgefið: [0.75, 1.25].

records.source: None (use the backbone)
records.translation: None (nota grunnnetið)

records.source: Open a folder before mapping segmentation uncertainty.
records.translation: Opnaðu möppu áður en þú kortleggur óvissu hlutagreiningar.

records.key: Open a folder before ranking fields by uncertainty.
records.source: Open a folder before ranking fields by uncertainty.
records.translation: Opnaðu möppu áður en þú raðar myndreitum eftir óvissu.

records.key: Optional label image of regions; each object is summarised under the region its centre falls in. Default empty.
records.source: Optional label image of regions; each object is summarised under the region its centre falls in. Default empty.
records.translation: Valfrjáls merkjamynd svæða; hver hlutur er tekinn saman undir því svæði sem miðja hans lendir í. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.key: Optional table of landmark pairs, with columns source_x, source_y (platform image pixels), target_x and target_y (your image's pixels); three or more pairs give an affine fit. Default empty.
records.source: Optional table of landmark pairs, with columns source_x, source_y (platform image pixels), target_x and target_y (your image's pixels); three or more pairs give an affine fit. Default empty.
records.translation: Valfrjáls tafla kennileitapara með dálkunum source_x, source_y (mynddílar kerfismyndar), target_x og target_y (mynddílar þinnar myndar); þrjú eða fleiri pör gefa affína aðlögun. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.key: Per-object intensity statistics, GLCM homogeneity and Zernike moments computed for all objects of a field at once on a CUDA GPU, matching the CPU values within float tolerance. Without a GPU the CPU path runs.
records.source: Per-object intensity statistics, GLCM homogeneity and Zernike moments computed for all objects of a field at once on a CUDA GPU, matching the CPU values within float tolerance. Without a GPU the CPU path runs.
records.translation: Styrktölfræði fyrir hvern hlut, GLCM-einsleitni og Zernike-vægi reiknuð samtímis fyrir alla hluti myndreits á CUDA GPU og samsvara CPU-gildum innan vikmarka fleytitalna. Án GPU er CPU-leiðin notuð.

records.source: Platform
records.translation: Kerfi

records.translation: Úttak kerfis

records.key: Published results: Dominguez Mantes et al., 'Spotiflow: accurate and efficient spot detection for fluorescence microscopy with deep stereographic flow regression', Nature Methods 2025 (doi:10.1038/s41592-025-02662-x). spaCR has not scored it against those results; it compared it with the native OPS detector and SpotNet on two real sequencing fields.
records.source: Published results: Dominguez Mantes et al., 'Spotiflow: accurate and efficient spot detection for fluorescence microscopy with deep stereographic flow regression', Nature Methods 2025 (doi:10.1038/s41592-025-02662-x). spaCR has not scored it against those results; it compared it with the native OPS detector and SpotNet on two real sequencing fields.
records.translation: Birtar niðurstöður: Dominguez Mantes et al., 'Spotiflow: accurate and efficient spot detection for fluorescence microscopy with deep stereographic flow regression', Nature Methods 2025 (doi:10.1038/s41592-025-02662-x). spaCR hefur ekki metið það gagnvart þessum niðurstöðum; það var borið saman við innbyggða OPS-greininn og SpotNet á tveimur raunverulegum raðgreiningarmyndreitum.

records.key: Pyramid level of the Xenium morphology image or the full resolution Visium image the masks were segmented on; each level halves the resolution. Default 0.
records.source: Pyramid level of the Xenium morphology image or the full resolution Visium image the masks were segmented on; each level halves the resolution. Default 0.
records.translation: Píramídastig Xenium-formgerðarmyndarinnar eða Visium-myndarinnar í fullri upplausn sem grímurnar voru hlutagreindar úr; hvert stig helmingar upplausnina. Sjálfgefið: 0.

records.key: Rank the fields, most uncertain first
records.source: Rank the fields, most uncertain first
records.translation: Raða myndreitum, óvissustu fyrst

records.source: Ranked {count} fields by segmentation uncertainty, the most uncertain first.
records.translation: Raðaði {count} myndreitum eftir óvissu hlutagreiningar, óvissustu fyrst.

records.source: Ranking by uncertainty would undo the blind order. Unblind first.
records.translation: Röðun eftir óvissu myndi afnema blinduðu röðina. Afblindaðu fyrst.

records.key: Re-segments a few sampled fields with the diameter, the thresholds and contrast enhancement each moved a little, and reports how much object counts, areas and intensities change, flagging the settings the results are fragile to.
records.source: Re-segments a few sampled fields with the diameter, the thresholds and contrast enhancement each moved a little, and reports how much object counts, areas and intensities change, flagging the settings the results are fragile to.
records.translation: Hlutagreinir nokkra úrtaksmyndreiti aftur með smávægilegum breytingum, hverri fyrir sig, á þvermáli, þröskuldum og birtuskilabætingu og greinir frá breytingum á hlutafjölda, flatarmáli og styrk. Merkir þær stillingar sem niðurstöðurnar eru viðkvæmar fyrir.

records.translation: Svæðisgríma

records.translation: Samstilltu Visium-punkta eða Xenium-umrit við hlutagreindu myndina og teldu hvert gen fyrir hverja frumu, kjarna, sýkil og safabólu.

records.key: Score each well against its own plate's negative control, or against the negative control of every plate together.
records.source: Score each well against its own plate's negative control, or against the negative control of every plate together.
records.translation: Gefur hverjum brunni stig miðað við neikvæða viðmiðið á hans eigin plötu eða neikvæð viðmið allra platna saman.

records.source: Seconds between the timelapse images of one event when microscope_timepoints is above 1. The watch waits at the event meanwhile, so long timelapses delay later fields. Default 0.
records.translation: Sekúndur milli tímaraðarmynda eins atburðar þegar microscope_timepoints er yfir 1. Vöktunin bíður við atburðinn á meðan, svo langar tímaraðir tefja seinni myndreiti. Sjálfgefið: 0.

records.source: Segmentation uncertainty {value} over {count} objects.
records.translation: Óvissa hlutagreiningar {value} yfir {count} hluti.

records.source: Side in pixels of the centre crop the robustness report cuts from each sampled field, to keep the grid fast, on a CPU especially. Blank or 0 re-segments whole fields. Default 512.
records.translation: Hliðarlengd í mynddílum á miðlægum útskurði sem þolskýrslan tekur úr hverjum úrtaksmyndreit til að flýta fyrir grindinni, sérstaklega á CPU. Tómt eða 0 hlutagreinir heila myndreiti aftur. Sjálfgefið: 512.

records.source: Smallest class probability, from 0 to 1, at which a frame is called an event; each event keeps the most probable frame within 2 frames. Raise it for fewer false events, lower it to miss fewer. Default 0.5.
records.translation: Lægstu flokkslíkur, frá 0 til 1, þar sem rammi telst atburður; hver atburður heldur líklegasta rammanum innan 2 ramma. Hækkaðu til að fækka fölskum atburðum, lækkaðu til að missa af færri. Sjálfgefið: 0.5.

records.source: Spatial transcriptomics
records.translation: Rýmisumritamengjafræði

records.key: Spotiflow 0.6.5 is BSD-3-Clause (Copyright 2023 Albert Dominguez Mantes and Martin Weigert). Its general, hybiss, synth_complex and fluo_live models are downloaded by Spotiflow itself from the weigertlab/spotiflow-models GitHub releases (BSD-3-Clause) into the backend's own folder. spaCR ships none of it.
records.source: Spotiflow 0.6.5 is BSD-3-Clause (Copyright 2023 Albert Dominguez Mantes and Martin Weigert). Its general, hybiss, synth_complex and fluo_live models are downloaded by Spotiflow itself from the weigertlab/spotiflow-models GitHub releases (BSD-3-Clause) into the backend's own folder. spaCR ships none of it.
records.translation: Spotiflow 0.6.5 er með BSD-3-Clause-leyfi (Copyright 2023 Albert Dominguez Mantes and Martin Weigert). Spotiflow sækir sjálft líkön sín general, hybiss, synth_complex og fluo_live úr GitHub-útgáfum weigertlab/spotiflow-models (BSD-3-Clause) í eigin möppu bakendans. spaCR dreifir engu af þessu.

records.key: Spotiflow finds SPOTS -- puncta, foci, FISH and sequencing spots, small parasites -- with sub-pixel coordinates. It runs in an environment of its own. Chosen by an object's model setting, each spot becomes a small disc in that object's mask, so spots are counted per cell like any other object; in OPS it is one of the sequencing-spot detectors.
records.source: Spotiflow finds SPOTS -- puncta, foci, FISH and sequencing spots, small parasites -- with sub-pixel coordinates. It runs in an environment of its own. Chosen by an object's model setting, each spot becomes a small disc in that object's mask, so spots are counted per cell like any other object; in OPS it is one of the sequencing-spot detectors.
records.translation: Spotiflow finnur PUNKTA -- punktmerki, bletti, FISH- og raðgreiningarpunkta, smá sníkjudýr -- með hnitum nákvæmari en einn mynddíll. Það keyrir í eigin umhverfi. Þegar það er valið í líkanstillingu hlutar verður hver punktur að litlum diski í grímu þess hlutar, svo punktar eru taldir fyrir hverja frumu eins og aðrir hlutir; í OPS er það einn af greinunum fyrir raðgreiningarpunkta.

records.key: Spotiflow's general model, run in its own environment; its spots go through the same base calls and nucleus assignment.
records.source: Spotiflow's general model, run in its own environment; its spots go through the same base calls and nucleus assignment.
records.translation: general-líkan Spotiflow, keyrt í eigin umhverfi; punktarnir fara í gegnum sömu basagreiningu og úthlutun til kjarna.

records.source: Table of hand-annotated events with columns field (the tracks file's field name), track_id, frame and event, plus an optional object column. Every event of an annotated field must be listed. The detector is scored on held-out annotated fields (precision, recall and timing error in frames, matched within 2 frames), trained on all of them and saved as tracks/events/event_model.pt. Blank uses timelapse_events_model. Default None.
records.translation: Tafla handmerktra atburða með dálkunum field (myndreitsnafn ferilslóðaskrárinnar), track_id, frame og event, ásamt valfrjálsum object-dálki. Alla atburði í merktum myndreit verður að telja upp. Greinirinn er metinn á fráteknum merktum myndreitum (hittni, heimt og tímaskekkja í römmum, parað innan 2 ramma), þjálfaður á þeim öllum og vistaður sem tracks/events/event_model.pt. Tómt gildi notar timelapse_events_model. Sjálfgefið: None.

records.source: Tables (*.csv *.tsv *.parquet *.feather *.xlsx)
records.translation: Töflur (*.csv *.tsv *.parquet *.feather *.xlsx)

records.key: The Space Ranger outs folder (Visium or Visium HD) or the Xenium output bundle. Default empty.
records.source: The Space Ranger outs folder (Visium or Visium HD) or the Xenium output bundle. Default empty.
records.translation: outs-mappa Space Ranger (Visium eða Visium HD) eða úttakspakki Xenium. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.key: The Visium HD bin size read from binned_outputs; ignored for Visium and Xenium. Default 8 µm.
records.source: The Visium HD bin size read from binned_outputs; ignored for Visium and Xenium. Default 8 µm.
records.translation: Reitastærð Visium HD lesin úr binned_outputs; hunsað fyrir Visium og Xenium. Sjálfgefið: 8 µm.

records.source: The folder of field images the simulated microscope acquires from, named as the watched images are and placed on the stage by microscope_positions. Blank uses src. Default blank.
records.translation: Mappa myndreitamynda sem hermda smásjáin tekur myndir úr, nefndar eins og vöktuðu myndirnar og staðsettar á borðinu með microscope_positions. Tómt gildi notar src. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.key: The gene the overlay is coloured by. Default the most counted gene.
records.source: The gene the overlay is coloured by. Default the most counted gene.
records.translation: Genið sem ræður lit yfirlagningarinnar. Sjálfgefið: mest talda genið.

records.key: The image the masks were segmented on. Empty or hires uses Visium's high-resolution image; lowres or full name the others; Xenium uses its morphology image. A file of your own microscope image of the same section is registered to the platform image, through the landmarks when given, else by image content. Default empty.
records.source: The image the masks were segmented on. Empty or hires uses Visium's high-resolution image; lowres or full name the others; Xenium uses its morphology image. A file of your own microscope image of the same section is registered to the platform image, through the landmarks when given, else by image content. Default empty.
records.translation: Myndin sem grímurnar voru hlutagreindar úr. Tómt eða hires notar háupplausnarmynd Visium; lowres eða full tilgreina hinar; Xenium notar formgerðarmynd sína. Skrá með eigin smásjármynd af sama sneiði er samstillt við kerfismyndina, með kennileitum þegar þau eru gefin, annars út frá myndinni sjálfri. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.source: The least certain is object {label} ({value}).
records.translation: Óvissastur er hlutur {label} ({value}).

records.key: The mail server password. Kept in the system keyring, or without one in a file only you can read, and never written to a log. Leave empty to keep the saved one. Default empty.
records.source: The mail server password. Kept in the system keyring, or without one in a file only you can read, and never written to a log. Leave empty to keep the saved one. Default empty.
records.translation: Lykilorð póstþjónsins. Geymt í lyklakippu kerfisins eða, ef hún er ekki til, í skrá sem aðeins þú getur lesið, og aldrei skrifað í annál. Hafðu tómt til að halda því vistaða. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.source: The measurement table whose objects can become events, such as cell, nucleus or pathogen. Each event is placed at the object's intensity-weighted centroid. Default 'cell'.
records.translation: Mælitaflan sem inniheldur hluti sem geta orðið atburðir, svo sem cell, nucleus eða pathogen. Hver atburður er staðsettur í styrkveginni þungamiðju hlutarins. Sjálfgefið: 'cell'.

records.key: The measurements.db the counts are written into, keyed by prcfo beside the object measurements. Default empty.
records.source: The measurements.db the counts are written into, keyed by prcfo beside the object measurements. Default empty.
records.translation: measurements.db sem talningarnar eru skrifaðar í, með prcfo sem lykil við hlið hlutamælinganna. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.source: The microscope microscope_feedback drives. 'simulated' acquires from the images in microscope_simulated_folder laid out at microscope_positions, for trying the loop without a microscope. 'pycromanager' drives a running Micro-Manager through pycro-manager (pip install pycromanager, and turn on Micro-Manager's server under Tools > Options). Default 'simulated'.
records.translation: Smásjáin sem microscope_feedback stýrir. 'simulated' tekur myndir úr microscope_simulated_folder, raðað samkvæmt microscope_positions, til að prófa lykkjuna án smásjár. 'pycromanager' stýrir keyrandi Micro-Manager í gegnum pycro-manager (pip install pycromanager og kveiktu á þjóni Micro-Manager undir Tools > Options). Sjálfgefið: 'simulated'.

records.source: The most events one field sends to the microscope, taken in table order, so a field full of matches does not hold up the plate. Default 10.
records.translation: Mesti fjöldi atburða sem einn myndreitur sendir til smásjárinnar, teknir í töfluröð, svo myndreitur fullur af samsvörunum tefji ekki plötuna. Sjálfgefið: 10.

records.key: The name you sign in to the mail server with, often your email address. Leave empty for a server that needs no sign-in. Default empty.
records.source: The name you sign in to the mail server with, often your email address. Leave empty for a server that needs no sign-in. Default empty.
records.translation: Nafnið sem þú notar til að skrá þig inn á póstþjóninn, oft netfangið þitt. Hafðu tómt fyrir þjón sem krefst ekki innskráningar. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.key: The outgoing mail server, for example smtp.example.org. Default empty.
records.source: The outgoing mail server, for example smtp.example.org. Default empty.
records.translation: Útsendingarpóstþjónninn, til dæmis smtp.example.org. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.key: The sender address. Empty uses the user name. Default empty.
records.source: The sender address. Empty uses the user name. Default empty.
records.translation: Netfang sendanda. Tómt gildi notar notandanafnið. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.key: The statistic that calls and ranks the hits. B-score removes row and column effects by median polish first.
records.source: The statistic that calls and ranks the hits. B-score removes row and column effects by median polish first.
records.translation: Tölfræðistærðin sem finnur og raðar jákvæðum niðurstöðum. B-score fjarlægir fyrst raða- og dálkaáhrif með miðgildissléttun.

records.key: The topic to publish to. On a public server anyone who knows the topic can read it, so choose one nobody would guess; it is kept like a password. Leave empty to keep the saved one. Default empty.
records.source: The topic to publish to. On a public server anyone who knows the topic can read it, so choose one nobody would guess; it is kept like a password. Leave empty to keep the saved one. Default empty.
records.translation: Efnisrásin sem á að birta á. Á opinberum þjóni getur hver sem þekkir efnisrásina lesið hana, svo veldu eina sem enginn myndi giska á; hún er varðveitt eins og lykilorð. Hafðu tómt til að halda þeirri vistuðu. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.translation: Atburðir í tímaröð

records.translation: Merkingar tímaraðaratburða

records.translation: Skilyrði tímaraðaratburða

records.translation: Líkan tímaraðaratburða

records.translation: Þröskuldur tímaraðaratburða

records.translation: Gluggi tímaraðaratburða

records.translation: Óvissa

records.translation: Óvissuútreikningur mistókst

records.source: Uncertainty map discarded because the field changed.
records.translation: Óvissukorti hent því myndreiturinn breyttist.

records.key: Uncertainty saved; the open fields changed while ranking, so their order was left alone.
records.source: Uncertainty saved; the open fields changed while ranking, so their order was left alone.
records.translation: Óvissa vistuð; opnu myndreitirnir breyttust meðan á röðun stóð, svo röð þeirra var látin óbreytt.

records.translation: Óvissustig ekki vistuð: {error}

records.translation: Óvissa…

records.translation: Visium HD-reitur

records.key: Well-label model: held-out well AUROC {mil:.2f} (mean-feature baseline {mean:.2f}) over {wells} wells. Cell attention and well probabilities were written beside the table.
records.source: Well-label model: held-out well AUROC {mil:.2f} (mean-feature baseline {mean:.2f}) over {wells} wells. Cell attention and well probabilities were written beside the table.
records.translation: Brunnmerkingalíkan: AUROC á fráteknum brunnum {mil:.2f} (viðmið með meðaleiginleikum {mean:.2f}) yfir {wells} brunna. Athyglisvægi frumna og líkur brunna voru skrifuð við hlið töflunnar.

records.key: Which platform wrote the folder. Detect reads it from the files present. Default Detect.
records.source: Which platform wrote the folder. Detect reads it from the files present. Default Detect.
records.translation: Hvaða kerfi skrifaði möppuna. Greina les það úr skránum sem eru til staðar. Sjálfgefið: Greina.

records.key: Who is told, one or more addresses separated by commas. Default empty.
records.source: Who is told, one or more addresses separated by commas. Default empty.
records.translation: Hverjum er tilkynnt, eitt eða fleiri netföng aðskilin með kommum. Sjálfgefið: tómt.

records.key: Wrote counts for {objects} objects to {db}; results in {output}.
records.source: Wrote counts for {objects} objects to {db}; results in {output}.
records.translation: Skrifaði talningar fyrir {objects} hluti í {db}; niðurstöður í {output}.

records.key: Xenium transcripts with a lower quality value (QV) are dropped, as Xenium's own cell-feature matrix drops them. Default 20.
records.source: Xenium transcripts with a lower quality value (QV) are dropped, as Xenium's own cell-feature matrix drops them. Default 20.
records.translation: Xenium-umrit með lægra gæðagildi (QV) eru felld út, eins og í eigin frumu-eiginleikafylki Xenium. Sjálfgefið: 20.

records.key: no source is open, so none of them can be shown. Open the experiment first.
records.source: no source is open, so none of them can be shown. Open the experiment first.
records.translation: engin uppspretta er opin svo ekki er hægt að sýna neina þeirra. Opnaðu tilraunina fyrst.

records.source: {platform}: {points} positions and {genes} genes, registered by {method}.
records.translation: {platform}: {points} stöður og {genes} gen, samstillt með {method}.

records.source: Cell mask
records.translation: Frumugríma

records.source: Cell-DINO (Meta FAIR DINOv2 on the Human Protein Atlas)
records.translation: Cell-DINO (Meta FAIR DINOv2 á Human Protein Atlas)

records.translation: ChAda-ViT (rásaaðlagað ViT-T/16, IDRCell100k)

records.translation: OpenPhenom (Recursion, rásaóháð MAE ViT-S/16)

records.translation: Sýklagríma

records.key: Read 10x Visium, Visium HD or Xenium output, place its spots or transcripts on the image spaCR segmented, and write gene counts per object beside the measurements. Default hidden.
records.source: Read 10x Visium, Visium HD or Xenium output, place its spots or transcripts on the image spaCR segmented, and write gene counts per object beside the measurements. Default hidden.
records.translation: Lestu úttak 10x Visium, Visium HD eða Xenium, staðsettu punkta þess eða umrit á myndinni sem spaCR hlutagreindi og skrifaðu genatalningar fyrir hvern hlut við hlið mælinganna. Sjálfgefið falið.

records.key: SubCell (CZI / Lundberg lab ViT-B/16, DNA + protein)
records.source: SubCell (CZI / Lundberg lab ViT-B/16, DNA + protein)
records.translation: SubCell (CZI / Lundberg lab ViT-B/16, DNA + prótein)

records.source: Vacuole mask
records.translation: Safabólugríma

records.source: s3://bucket/folder, gs://, az:// or https://
records.translation: s3://bucket/folder, gs://, az:// eða https://

retired_records.key: Mapping segmentation uncertainty: four detection runs…
retired_records.source: Mapping segmentation uncertainty: four detection runs…

retired_records.key: Ranking {count} fields by segmentation uncertainty: four detection runs each…
retired_records.source: Ranking {count} fields by segmentation uncertainty: four detection runs each…
retired_records.translation: Raða {count} myndreitum eftir óvissu hlutagreiningar: fjórar greiningarkeyrslur hver…

retired_records.key: Segment each field four times, as it is, flipped two ways and turned a quarter, with the Object detection settings, and measure where the four disagree. Map this field shows the disagreement as a heat map on its own tab; Rank the fields puts the most uncertain fields first and saves the scores as curate_uncertainty.csv for spacr-make-masks --order uncertain. Takes four detection runs per field.
retired_records.source: Segment each field four times, as it is, flipped two ways and turned a quarter, with the Object detection settings, and measure where the four disagree. Map this field shows the disagreement as a heat map on its own tab; Rank the fields puts the most uncertain fields first and saves the scores as curate_uncertainty.csv for spacr-make-masks --order uncertain. Takes four detection runs per field.
retired_records.translation: Hlutagreindu hvern myndreit fjórum sinnum, óbreyttan, speglaðan á tvo vegu og snúinn um fjórðung úr hring, með stillingum hlutgreiningar, og mældu hvar niðurstöðurnar fjórar eru ósammála. Kortleggja þennan myndreit sýnir ósamræmið sem hitakort á eigin flipa; Raða myndreitum setur óvissustu myndreitina fremst og vistar stigin sem curate_uncertainty.csv fyrir spacr-make-masks --order uncertain. Krefst fjögurra greiningarkeyrslna fyrir hvern myndreit.

retired_records.source: Compute the per-object intensity statistics, GLCM homogeneity and Zernike moments on a CUDA GPU through PyTorch, all objects of a field at once instead of one at a time. Values match the CPU run within float tolerance. Covers 2-D masks without voxel spacing; anything else, a missing PyTorch or no visible CUDA device measures on the CPU as usual. Default False.
retired_records.translation: Reiknar styrktölfræði fyrir hvern hlut, GLCM-einsleitni og Zernike-vægi á CUDA GPU í gegnum PyTorch, fyrir alla hluti myndreits samtímis í stað eins í einu. Gildin samsvara CPU-keyrslu innan vikmarka fleytitalna. Gildir fyrir 2-D-grímur án rúmpunktabils; í öðrum tilvikum, ef PyTorch vantar eða ekkert CUDA-tæki er sýnilegt, fer mæling fram á CPU eins og venjulega. Sjálfgefið: False.
